companies.name: Pixxel

evidence.title: Hyperspectral Intelligence in Agriculture
evidence.note: Company agriculture article describes 5 m hyperspectral imagery for plant stress and crop classification.

evidence.title: Pixxel Product Specifications Guide

companies.fresher_fyp_should_signal: Hyperspectral literacy: narrow-band stress indices, calibration/quality masking, and a demo that shows what hyperspectral detects earlier or cleaner than Sentinel-2.

forcing_functions.name: Digital Agriculture Mission / AgriStack / Krishi-DSS rollout
forcing_functions.why_it_creates_a_gap: The Mission targets all districts for Digital Crop Survey by FY 2025-26 and creates Krishi-DSS with remote-sensing crop, soil, weather and water layers, raising demand for validated satellite-derived crop maps and advisories.

evidence.title: Cabinet approves the Digital Agriculture Mission
evidence.note: PIB says Digital Crop Survey targets all districts in FY 2025-26 and Krishi-DSS unifies remote-sensing data.

forcing_functions.name: ISRO/DoS SASYA and open/free coarser-than-5m remote sensing data
forcing_functions.why_it_creates_a_gap: SASYA makes C-band SAR crop mapping available to operational agencies and Indian policy makes remote-sensing data coarser than 5 m open/free, enabling FYPs around SAR crop maps and public operational validation.

evidence.title: Parliament Question: Space-Based Initiatives for Agriculture
evidence.note: PIB states SASYA for C-band SAR is integrated into BHOONIDHI and coarser-than-5m remote-sensing data is free/open.

forcing_functions.name: Namo Drone Didi scheme through 2025-26
forcing_functions.why_it_creates_a_gap: The scheme subsidizes drone packages and training for women SHGs providing farm rental services, creating demand for simple, low-cost drone operations, spray records and imagery-driven service QA.

evidence.title: The 'Namo Drone Didi' scheme will provide new opportunities and empowerment to rural women
evidence.note: PIB gives outlay, 80% assistance up to Rs 8 lakh and scheme period 2023-24 to 2025-26.

forcing_functions.name: RBI KCC Directions 2026 effective for new loans
forcing_functions.why_it_creates_a_gap: The Directions include drone-based crop health surveys, spraying services, remote sensing and satellite-based crop monitoring within working-capital limit arithmetic, creating lender demand for auditable crop/acreage/end-use signals.

evidence.title: Reserve Bank of India [Regional Rural Banks - Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme] Directions, 2026
